rationale: Recanonicalize the local Jacksonville concession as Dames Point Jacksonville LLC, distinguish it from the broader Ceres platform sold to Carrix, record Macquarie as a 2022-2023 former owner, and add JAXPORT as the continuing legal owner while treating SSA solely as operator.

supports: Ceres acquired 100% of TraPac Jacksonville effective March 1, 2022.
The business held the Dames Point terminal and ICTF lease.
Jacksonville and its ICTF were excluded from Macquarie's sale of the broader Ceres platform.
The local SPV was renamed Dames Point Jacksonville LLC and held through MIP III Bluefin B Holdco.
JAXPORT acquired the local business and assets in November 2023 and remains the public-port owner.
SSA operates Dames Point; no equity ownership by SSA is evidenced.

companyFieldUpdates.name: Dames Point Jacksonville LLC
companyFieldUpdates.description: Dames Point Jacksonville LLC is the local operating and concession entity associated with JAXPORT's 158-acre Dames Point container terminal and adjacent intermodal container transfer facility in Jacksonville, Florida. The business handles container, stevedoring, crane, yard and rail-transfer activity for ocean carriers, cargo owners and military users under long-term port rights. Ceres acquired the former TraPac Jacksonville entity in 2022; Macquarie retained the renamed local SPV when the broader Ceres platform was sold to Carrix, then sold the Jacksonville business and assets separately to JAXPORT in November 2023. JAXPORT is the current owner and SSA is the contract operator, not an equity owner.
